title: Bootstrap and readiness: three real clients join one world
description: Isolated stack, three rendered players with distinct device ids. Proves identity, one shared game server (ADR-2), sessions, and that every client receives snapshots at the world rate.

assertions.title: all clients assigned the same game server
one session per user, one server per map
every client ran the scenario to the end
no exception in any player log
snapshots arrive at the world rate
no dropped datagrams or closed sessions
